reason: Both are asset-based North American motor carriers earning per-load freight fees, with some brokerage. J.B. Hunt is a diversified, multi-mode shipper-facing network (intermodal, dedicated, brokerage, final-mile) serving retail, consumer goods and manufacturing shippers. Proficient is a niche finished-vehicle car-hauler serving automakers, dealers and auctions. The trucking and brokerage product overlap is partial, and the customer base is largely different. That gives adjacent, not direct.
